python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data from treasury bulletins - FY 1945-1959 surplus/deficit in millions
# From 1954 bulletin: 1945, 1946, 1947
# From 1960 bulletin: 1948-1959

data = [
    -53941,  # 1945 (from 1954 bulletin)
    -20676,  # 1946 (from 1954 bulletin)
    754,     # 1947 (from 1954 bulletin)
    8419,    # 1948 (from 1960 bulletin)
    -1811,   # 1949 (from 1960 bulletin)
    -3122,   # 1950 (from 1960 bulletin)
    3510,    # 1951 (from 1960 bulletin)
    -4017,   # 1952 (from 1960 bulletin)
    -9449,   # 1953 (from 1960 bulletin)
    -3117,   # 1954 (from 1960 bulletin)
    -4180,   # 1955 (from 1960 bulletin)
    1626,    # 1956 (from 1960 bulletin)
    1596,    # 1957 (from 1960 bulletin)
    -2819,   # 1958 (from 1960 bulletin)
    -12427,  # 1959 (from 1960 bulletin)
]

print("Data for FY 1945-1959:")
for i, year in enumerate(range(1945, 1960)):
    print(f"{year}: {data[i]}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation
n = len(data)
mean = sum(data) / n
print(f"\nMean: {mean}")

# Calculate sum of squared deviations
sum_squared_devs = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in data)
print(f"Sum of squared deviations: {sum_squared_devs}")

# Sample standard deviation (n-1 denominator)
sample_std = math.sqrt(sum_squared_devs / (n - 1))
print(f"\nSample standard deviation: {sample_std}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest thousandths: {round(sample_std, 3)}")
EOF
